# Zoho Recruit | Industry Solutions

| Industry / segment | Adaptation notes |
| --- | --- |
| Applicable industries / segments | Employment agencies, IT, manufacturing, education, medical and professional services are the main sectors of application. Industry adaptation should not only look at template names but also check field models, approval chains, local rules, statements, interfaces and partner delivery experience. |
| Standard process-type industry | Prioritize the assessment of opener templates, go-live speed and user adoption rates. |
| Complex operating industry | Key certification rule engine, batch processing, unusual correction, audit and peak performance. |
| Cross-regional organizations | Focus on validation of multi-currency/multilingual/multi-legal persons, data presence, cross-border transmission and local support. |
| Strong regulation of industry | Certification is only for input and requires review of contracts, DPA, logs, retention deletions, business continuity and accountability interfaces. |
